# ORCHID

> Open Repository for CALPHAD Hypotheses, Intelligence, and Discovery (Texas A&M University). Openly licensed CALPHAD
> thermodynamic databases (TDB), binary convex hulls (DFT and CALPHAD) and, as they pass review, evaluated
> phase-equilibrium and thermochemical data. Every value carries its source, licence and evidence class.

Evidence classes are never mixed: experimental | model (linked to the exact TDB file by SHA-256) | dft | assessed_phase_diagram.

## Data
- [Catalog (JSON)](https://orchid-project.org/data/catalog.json): one record per database: name, elements, phases, tier, licence, source URL.
- [Catalog (CSV)](https://orchid-project.org/data/catalog.csv)
- [Bundled TDB files](https://github.com/orchid-calphad/orchid-project.org/tree/main/data/databases): redistributable databases; licences in data/NOTICE.md.
- [DFT hulls, Materials Project v2026.04.13](https://github.com/orchid-calphad/orchid-project.org/tree/main/data/hulls/dft-mp): one JSON per binary system, interval schema.
- [DFT hulls, OQMD v1.8](https://github.com/orchid-calphad/orchid-project.org/tree/main/data/hulls/dft-oqmd): same schema; fitted elemental references (not comparable in energy to MP).
- [CALPHAD hulls, SGTE](https://github.com/orchid-calphad/orchid-project.org/tree/main/data/hulls/calphad-sgte)
- [Literature data, all records (CSV.gz)](https://orchid-project.org/data/literature/orchid-literature.csv.gz): invariant reactions, transitions, phase compositions, thermochemical and structural values from published papers; evidence class, units, T (K) and pressure, phases and compositions (mole fraction), method, conditions, citation + DOI, verbatim quote + page, flags. Nested fields are JSON strings.
- [Literature data (JSONL.gz)](https://orchid-project.org/data/literature/orchid-literature.jsonl.gz): same records, one JSON object per line.
- [Literature data per system](https://orchid-project.org/data/literature/index.json): index of data/literature/systems/<SYS>.json (SYS = sorted uppercase elements joined by '-', e.g. AL-NI).
- [Literature papers](https://orchid-project.org/data/literature/papers.json) and [experimental contexts](https://orchid-project.org/data/literature/contexts.json); field reference: [SCHEMA.md](https://orchid-project.org/data/literature/SCHEMA.md); about: https://orchid-project.org/dataset/
- [DFT vs experiment, formation enthalpies (JSON)](https://orchid-project.org/data/literature/dft_parity.json): literature HM_FORM values (kJ/mol-atom) paired with the lowest-energy Materials Project and OQMD entry at the same binary composition (separate sources, never averaged); matching rules, exclusions, per-source MAE/RMSE/r. Viewer: https://orchid-project.org/dft-parity/
- [Croissant metadata](https://orchid-project.org/data/croissant.json)

## Notes
- DFT layers carry formation enthalpy only; reference kinds differ between sources and must not be averaged.
- Literature data: derived data CC BY 4.0 (cite ORCHID and each value's source paper); each quote is one sentence under fair use; source papers are not redistributed. Use only records with flags.extraction_accepted = true unless you handle disputes; uncertainty with basis stated_default is a placeholder, not a measurement.
- Files we may not redistribute are listed in the catalog with links to their original sources only.
- Cite releases by their Zenodo DOI; see CITATION.cff.
